mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.2% compresses discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods of FEDFUNDS <= 0.2% are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the rate is not sustained for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 10.0%, it signals severe labor market contraction and increased recession risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns in periods where UNRATE > 10.0 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met in >60% of cases without negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 and employment (PAYEMS) falls below 130000, it indicates simultaneous supply and labor market contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns in periods where INDPRO < 90 AND PAYEMS < 130000 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met in >60% of cases without negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: In a zero-lower-bound monetary policy regime (FEDFUNDS <= 0.2%) with low inflation (CPIAUCSL month-over-month change < 0.5%), the economy is stable and equity valuations are supported, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: zero lower bound with low inflation
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns in the regime (FEDFUNDS<=0.2 and CPIAUCSL m/m <0.5) are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the regime condition is met in >60% of cases without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: Higher housing starts (HOUST) indicate a strengthening housing market and economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring a threshold condition.
failure_condition: The correlation between HOUST and SPX 20-day returns is not positive and significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90, it signals a severe manufacturing output contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns in periods where INDPRO < 90 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met in >60% of cases without negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 350000 and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.2%, it indicates strong consumer demand and accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand with low rates
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns in periods where RSAFS > 350000 AND FEDFUNDS <=0.2 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met in >60% of cases without positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: When quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) declines (GDPC1 (q/q) < 0), it signals an economic contraction, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns in periods where GDPC1 (q/q) < 0 are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) or the condition is met in >60% of cases without negative returns.
